description_full: Capital Tankers Corp. operates crude and product tankers. The company owns a fleet of 30 vessels comprising 12 crude carriers, 10 Suezmax tankers, and 8 Aframax/LR2 tankers. It serves customers in the global crude oil transportation sector. Capital Tankers Corp. was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece. Capital Tankers Corp. operates as a subsidiary of Capital Maritime & Trading Corp.
ceo_bio: Mr. Gerasimos G. Kalogiratos | Chief Executive Officer | Age 48
financial_summary: CAPITAL TANKERS CORP. is a mid-cap industrials business with a $2.6B market cap on $41M of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at 2% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 42%.
The company is burning through $191M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 4.2× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss.

Net dilution runs at 2.7% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 3.3× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
